method: 15 GitHub repository searches, stars descending, at most40 results per query; explicit user and primary-source/directory seeds added. Deduplicated bounded discovery, not an exhaustive census.
inspection_scope: Repository search metadata plus pinned README, recursive tree media paths and up to3 releases for selected candidates. All high-star relevant candidates found by this bounded discovery are retained; adjacent matches are classified separately. No competitor native tools run. No private competitor traffic available.
